# covidexplorer

An R package with a Shiny app for exploring how new COVID-19 cases and
vaccination coverage moved together across countries during the Delta
period (June to November 2021).

**Intended user:** public health students comparing how countries fared
during the Delta wave.

**Question:** How did new COVID-19 cases move alongside vaccination
coverage in different countries during the Delta period?

Documentation website:
<https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-vpat0051/>

## Data

`covid_delta` is a cleaned subset of the [Our World in Data COVID-19
dataset](https://github.com/owid/covid-19-data) (Mathieu, Ritchie et
al.), licensed CC BY. It covers 1 June to 30 November 2021 and includes
new cases and deaths per million (7-day average), the share of people
fully vaccinated, and a stringency index. The source repository stopped
updating in August 2024. The cleaning steps are in
`data-raw/covid_delta.R`.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ETC5523-2026/etc5523-assignment-4-vpat0051")
```

## Launch the app

``` r

library(covidexplorer)
launch_app()
```

You can also summarise the case peak and vaccination coverage for chosen
countries without the app:

``` r

summarise_delta(c("Australia", "India"))
```
